per.section: The tick verdict — one facts artifact

acceptance: a singleton tick whose span merged and whose `afterMerge` gates passed carries `gatedTip`; one whose span was reverted, refused or never picked carries none; and a fanout ship whose ledger rewrite exited tip-claimed carries none with `tipMoved` set
tests: a singleton tick whose span merged reports the gated tip it left
a singleton tick whose afterMerge gates reverted its span reports no gated tip
a fanout ship whose ledger rewrite a foreign tip claim stopped reports no gated tip
notes: `gatedTip` is set in `src/waveMerge.ts` alone, so every singleton verdict withholds it and a step delivering trunk infers one from commit subjects instead. The fanout half: `commitAttemptLedger` returns normally on a `tip-claimed` rewrite — it sets `tipMoved` and the caller still reads the tip, which may then name a commit no gate of this tick judged.
